description: Canonical transition allowlist for the Linear live operating surface (AGENTS-189 epic). The gated board-mover (AGENTS-190) MUST reject any (from,to,by) tuple not present here, and MUST enforce every listed condition before performing the move. MJ is the universal override.

conditions_glossary.grounding_and_contract_present: Triage output has grounding_doc(schema=team_os.grounding.v1) + thin_contract attached to the issue.
conditions_glossary.assignee_set_cto: Issue assignee is set to the CTO at the same time as the move.
conditions_glossary.worker_handoff_present: A worker handoff JSON with claims[]+diff_substrings[] exists for this issue's run.
conditions_glossary.classified_low_cost: failure_cost classifier returned low-cost AND reversible with confidence; uncertainty => false.
conditions_glossary.no_denied_surface: The contract's touched surfaces intersect NONE of denied_surfaces.
conditions_glossary.validator_pass_independent: Claude-Max adversarial review verdict=PASS with REAL runtime session_id != REAL author session_id (not self-declared labels).
conditions_glossary.human_gate_label_absent: Issue does NOT carry the 'gate:human' label.
conditions_glossary.mj_approved: MJ moved the card Needs-MJ -> Approved on Linear; that human decision is what fires the Integrator.
conditions_glossary.landing_evidence_present: Integrator verified a real landed commit sha in a local repo (git cat-file) OR an explicit no-code/investigation-only declaration in the chain (AGENTS-244 gate).

transitions.note: Cortex claims one eligible item for triage.
Gate-only Cortex hands off to CTO. Cortex MUST NOT author the fix.
Consequential OR carries gate:human label OR classifier uncertain.
CTO claims and starts the engine slice.
AUTO-DONE. All four conditions required. Any failure => route to Needs-MJ instead.
Consequential / denied-surface / uncertain / gate:human / not low-cost.
ONLY MJ closes a gated ticket.

AGENTS-238 final hop. MJ's Approved IS the human closure decision; the Integrator performs the mechanical Done move and posts the human-language landed-summary. Empty landings are bounced before this point (AGENTS-244).

producer_creates.note: New issues (incl. Sentinel regression re-opens) are CREATED in Backlog with a link back to the source issue. Sentinel never moves a Done card back; it creates a new linked ticket.

human_override.note: MJ can drag any card to any lane at any time; agents respect the new lane on their next tick.

invariants: Done is reachable only by mj (from Needs-MJ), by validator from In Review with ALL four auto-Done conditions true, or by integrator from Approved after MJ's Approved decision with validator PASS + landing evidence (AGENTS-238).
A ticket whose contract touches any denied_surface can NEVER auto-Done; it MUST route In Review -> Needs-MJ.
Cortex is gate-only: it may not enter In Progress / In Review / Done, may not author fixes, may not write *VALIDATION* artifacts.
auto-Done requires an independent validator PASS proven by REAL differing runtime session ids, not self-declared JSON labels.
The classifier fails closed: any uncertainty about cost/surface routes to Needs-MJ, never auto-Done.
Every move is idempotent through the outbox (op_id) so retries cannot double-post.
